steps.note: put(dune): append 23 bytes at offset 0 (12-byte header + key + value), then point the index at it.
put(emma): append 22 bytes at offset 23 (12-byte header + key + value), then point the index at it.
put(dune) again: a new record is appended at offset 45. The index now points there; the old record is garbage, still on disk.
delete(emma): append a tombstone (value length −1) and drop the key from the index. Nothing is erased in place.
get(dune): one hash lookup gives offset 45, then one read at that offset: "F. Herbert".
put(solaris): append 22 bytes at offset 87 (12-byte header + key + value), then point the index at it.
compact(): copy only the live records into a new file and rename it over the old one. 109 bytes → 48; the 61 bytes of garbage are gone.
put(cat): goes into the memtable, a sorted map in memory (a TreeMap here; RocksDB uses a skip list).
put(ant): goes into the memtable, a sorted map in memory (a TreeMap here; RocksDB uses a skip list).
put(eel): goes into the memtable, a sorted map in memory (a TreeMap here; RocksDB uses a skip list).
The memtable is full (3 keys in this demo), so it's written out in key order as an immutable SSTable, in one sequential write.
Three more puts, including a newer value for cat. The old cat=1 in sst-0000 is not touched.
Flush again: a second SSTable. Newest tables are listed first, because a read must check them first.
delete(ant): a tombstone goes into the memtable. It must hide ant=1 in the older table until a merge removes both.
get(cat): not in the memtable. sst-0001: found "2". Stop here: anything in an older table is an older version.
get(dog): not in the memtable. sst-0001: Bloom filter says no, file not read. sst-0000: Bloom filter says no, file not read.
get(ant): found in the memtable as a tombstone, so the answer is null. Older tables are never asked.
Flush the tombstone into its own SSTable. Three files now: every read of a missing key could cost three probes without Bloom filters.
compact(): merge all tables like merge sort's merge step. For each key keep only the newest version; drop the tombstone and the ant=1 it was hiding. One file, no garbage.
